thing_279.description: A reinforced leather courier bag with sealed seams to protect letters from snow and wind during long routes.
thing_279.shortDescription: Reinforced leather courier bag with sealed seams for mail delivery.

metadata.properties: Protects contents from moisture and wind damage.

thing_280.name: Iron Route Marker
thing_280.description: A small, heavy iron stake driven into the ground to mark the safe path across the frozen tundra.
thing_280.shortDescription: Heavy iron stake marking the safe path on the frozen tundra.

metadata.properties: None

thing_281.name: Thermal Hand Warmer
thing_281.description: A small copper coil device that glows faintly warm, kept in a pocket to prevent frostbite during long waits.
thing_281.shortDescription: Copper coil device providing steady heat for frozen extremities.

metadata.properties: Provides steady heat for 1 hour.

thing_282.name: Compressed Snow Cake
thing_282.description: A dense, energy-rich ration bar made of compressed roots and nuts, wrapped in wax paper for portability.
thing_282.shortDescription: Dense energy ration bar wrapped in wax paper for portability.

metadata.properties: Edible ration for survival situations.

thing_283.name: Whistle of the Ridge
thing_283.description: A simple bone whistle used by couriers to signal location in whiteout conditions or to alert nearby stations.
thing_283.shortDescription: Bone whistle for signaling location in whiteout conditions.

metadata.properties: Carries sound well over long distances in cold air.

thing_284.name: Permafrost-Bound Compass
thing_284.description: A brass compass encased in thick, clear ice. The needle doesn't point north, but towards the nearest source of warmth or life. The ice never melts, even in summer.

thing_285.name: Snow-Crusted Pine Boughs
thing_285.description: Dead branches from the ancient pines, heavy with compacted snow. They crunch underfoot and offer little utility beyond marking the path.

thing_286.name: Wind-Battered Stone Cairn
thing_286.description: The central cairn is worn smooth by centuries of wind and snow. The iron ring is rusted shut, useless for tethering but solid enough to lean against.

thing_287.name: Residual Warmth Circle
thing_287.description: The patch of ground at the center of the pines remains surprisingly warm. The snow here is thinner, revealing dark, damp earth that smells of life.

thing_288.name: Scrap Metal Strip
thing_288.description: Thin, bent strips of rusted iron scavenged from the Frost March. They have no structural integrity but can be melted down for small trades.
thing_288.shortDescription: Rusted iron strips found in the snow. Heavy and useless.

metadata.properties: Heavy and dull. Good for scratching ice or bartering with mechanics.

thing_289.name: Warm Paw Treats
thing_289.description: Small, dense biscuits made of dried fish and bone meal. They smell strong but provide quick energy for working animals or hungry trackers.
thing_289.shortDescription: Dried fish biscuits for animals or hungry people.

metadata.properties: Edible. Smells like fish. Good for bribing cats.

thing_290.name: Shiny Pebble
thing_290.description: A smooth, white quartz stone with a glass-like luster. It catches the light well and is perfect for distracting cats or adding to a collection.
thing_290.shortDescription: A smooth white stone that catches the light nicely.

metadata.properties: Smooth to the touch. Reflects sunlight brightly.

thing_291.name: Wool Scarf
thing_291.description: A coarse, knitted scarf dyed a faded red. It is worn thin at the edges but still provides decent protection against the wind.
thing_291.shortDescription: Faded red scarf that keeps the neck warm.

metadata.properties: Warm but itchy. Retains heat well.

thing_292.name: Frost-Weaver's Shroud
thing_292.description: A lightweight cloak woven from the silk of arctic spiders, treated with a mild freezing charm to keep the wearer cool in summer and provide a layer of wind resistance in winter. It lacks significant magical power but is a staple for travelers in the tundra who need mobility over heavy protection.

thing_293.name: QA Frost March Signpost
thing_293.description: A rusted metal post with a faded enamel sign reading "QA FROST MARCH - HYDRATION ZONE 4". The paint is peeling, and the metal is cold to the touch, reflecting the harsh environment. It marks a boundary for the automated testing sectors.

thing_294.name: Bleached Bone Cairn
thing_294.description: A small, neat pile of white bones, likely from local wildlife, stacked with precision. Unlike the stone cairns, this one suggests a ritualistic or territorial marking by a creature with keen intelligence. The wind whistles through the gaps.

thing_295.name: Cracked Ice Shard
thing_295.description: A jagged, translucent shard of ice torn from the base of the tower. It is sharp enough to cut but melts quickly in the hand. It holds no magical value, merely a remnant of the frozen landscape.

thing_296.name: Anchor Maintenance Chisel
thing_296.description: A heavy iron chisel with a handle wrapped in frozen leather, used by Rin to chip away excess frost from the tower's magical anchor.
thing_296.shortDescription: Frost-rusted chisel for tower anchor maintenance

metadata.properties: Designed for precision work on magical stone.

thing_297.name: Crystal Shard Collection
thing_297.description: Small, geometric fragments of ice harvested from the northern ridge, kept by Rin for her personal collection and study of snow crystal formations.
thing_297.shortDescription: Twelve pristine ice crystals from the northern ridge

metadata.properties: Each shard is perfectly clear and never melts.

thing_298.name: Thermal Flask
thing_298.description: A dented metal flask filled with hot tea, kept warm by a minor enchantment to provide comfort during long shifts in the blizzard.
thing_298.shortDescription: Enchanted flask of hot tea for cold weather comfort

metadata.properties: Provides warmth but does not restore mana.

thing_299.name: Windproof Lantern
thing_299.description: A brass lantern with reinforced glass panels, designed to burn steadily even in the strongest gales on the tundra.

thing_300.name: QA Restorative Meal
thing_300.description: A complete prepared meal used for deterministic need-bar and timed status-effect lifecycle tests.

thing_301.name: Worn Canvas Satchel
thing_301.description: A heavy, canvas shoulder bag reinforced with leather straps, showing signs of constant use and travel.
thing_301.shortDescription: Durable canvas bag for carrying basic travel supplies and tools.

metadata.properties: Provides basic protection for carried goods against dirt and minor moisture.

thing_302.name: Thick Wool Scarf
thing_302.description: A coarse, knitted scarf dyed in faded earth tones, providing essential warmth against the biting wind.
thing_302.shortDescription: Faded wool scarf offering modest protection from winter winds.

metadata.properties: Reduces fatigue from cold exposure during long treks.

thing_303.name: Tough Leather Boots
thing_303.description: Sturdy boots with thick soles, scuffed and stained from miles of walking on rough terrain.
thing_303.shortDescription: Scuffed leather boots providing reliable footing for laborers.

metadata.properties: Provides good traction on slippery or uneven ground.

thing_304.name: Iron Rations Bar
thing_304.description: Dense, hard biscuits wrapped in wax paper, designed to last for days without spoiling in cold weather.
thing_304.shortDescription: Hardtack-style ration bars for extended travel without fresh food.

metadata.properties: Tastes like sawdust but keeps hunger at bay for a short time.

thing_305.name: Small Whetstone
thing_305.description: A rough, grey stone used for sharpening blades, wrapped in a strip of cloth to keep it from chipping.
thing_305.shortDescription: Basic stone for keeping a blade sharp during long journeys.

metadata.properties: Allows for minor maintenance of edged weapons to prevent dulling.

thing_306.name: Frost-Touched Pinecone
thing_306.description: A large, resinous pinecone dusted with a permanent layer of frost, found near the lodge's entrance.

thing_307.name: Frost-Bleached Deck Board
thing_307.description: A sturdy but worn plank from the lodge's exterior deck, bleached by the northern sun. This Frost-Bleached Deck Board shows signs of hard use.

thing_308.name: Ember-Hearth Ash Pile
thing_308.description: A small, warm pile of ash from the previous night's fire, still radiating a gentle heat.

thing_309.name: Bone-Crystal Chime
thing_309.description: Carved from frozen bone and crystal, this Bone-Crystal Chime emits a soft, melodic hum when the wind blows.

thing_310.name: Thermal Weave Mittens
thing_310.description: Mittens woven with heat-retaining fibers, keeping hands warm even in the deepest frosts.

thing_311.name: Ember Hearth Apron
thing_311.description: Thick, heat-resistant canvas apron reinforced with iron rivets. It bears the faint scent of pine smoke and old stew.
thing_311.shortDescription: Heat-resistant canvas apron with iron rivets

metadata.properties: Resistant to heat and grease stains.

thing_312.name: Oni Kitchen Cleaver
thing_312.description: A heavy, single-edged blade forged from dark steel. The handle is wrapped in worn leather, designed for powerful chopping motions.

thing_313.name: Resin-Bound Lantern
thing_313.description: A sturdy iron lantern filled with glowing pine resin. It provides warm, steady light and resists wind and moisture.
thing_313.shortDescription: Iron lantern with glowing pine resin fuel

metadata.properties: Provides light in dark areas. Burns for 8 hours.

thing_314.name: Warm Wool Scarf
thing_314.description: A thick, knitted scarf dyed deep red. It traps body heat effectively and smells faintly of lavender.
thing_314.shortDescription: Thick red wool scarf for warmth

metadata.properties: Reduces cold exposure penalty.

thing_315.name: Iron Ladle
thing_315.description: A long-handled ladle made of black iron. It is heavy enough to be used as a makeshift weapon in a pinch.
thing_315.shortDescription: Heavy iron ladle for serving or combat

metadata.properties: Can be used to serve soup or block attacks.

thing_316.name: Aether Pitch Fork
thing_316.description: A silver fork that vibrates at a specific frequency to test the pitch of instruments or the stability of magical enchantments using Aether Pitch Fork.
thing_316.shortDescription: Silver fork for tuning instruments and magic

metadata.properties: Used for precise auditory calibration.

thing_317.name: Sea Glass Pendant
thing_317.description: A smooth, frosted blue stone worn on a leather cord, gifted by a traveler and kept for its calming aesthetic.
thing_317.shortDescription: Frosted blue stone on leather cord

metadata.properties: Simple trinket with a faint magical resonance.

thing_318.name: Wool Travel Scarf
thing_318.description: A thick, dark gray scarf woven from coarse wool, providing warmth against the biting winds of the northern marches.
thing_318.shortDescription: Thick gray wool scarf for cold protection

metadata.properties: Provides modest protection against cold weather.

thing_319.name: Sea Brine Flask
thing_319.description: A small glass vial filled with brine from the sea, used by the Siren to maintain moisture in her gills during long dry spells using Sea Brine Flask.
thing_319.shortDescription: Small glass vial of brine for gill maintenance

metadata.properties: Essential for Siren hydration in dry environments.

thing_320.name: Resin-Bound Lantern
thing_320.description: Iron lantern with glowing pine resin fuel, providing steady light in the lodge's dim corners.
thing_320.shortDescription: Iron lantern with glowing pine resin fuel

metadata.properties: Emits a soft, warm glow that helps maintain the lodge's ambient temperature slightly.

thing_321.name: Torque Wrench
thing_321.description: A heavy, calibrated wrench used for tightening structural bolts on the lodge's timber frame.
thing_321.shortDescription: Calibrated wrench for structural timber bolts

metadata.properties: Provides precise torque measurement for structural maintenance.

thing_322.name: Moisture Sealant Canister
thing_322.description: Small metal canisters filled with alchemical gel used to seal wood grain against rot and frost.

thing_323.name: Foundation Compass
thing_323.description: A brass compass encased in iron, specifically tuned to detect shifts in the earth's pressure and timber alignment.

thing_324.name: Lint Roller
thing_324.description: A wide, adhesive roller used for cleaning dust and debris from the lodge's wool blankets and upholstery.

thing_325.name: QA Short Tonic
thing_325.description: A measured tonic used to verify ten-minute status duration and expiry across long actions.
